fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-22 11:30 to 2026-10-23 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: two, both still open, and they are one question from two ends.
- bf4a5af5 (filed 10-22 00:14, about 35h old, still in draft): may the diagnostics lists on about 16 command results change from plain text to objects (srs-rust#1264)? Why it matters: every current reader (srs-web, srs-vscode, scripts, MCP clients) breaks on the day the new build is pinned. Options: (A) replace everywhere in one release; (B) add a structured list beside the text one, retire the text later; (C) code on validation results first, other surfaces later; (D) do nothing. Recommendation: C first, then B. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium.
- c7fefad9 (new 10-22 18:14, proposed): the builder's queue is empty because srs-rust#1339 (structured diagnostics on the remaining payloads) needs the shape that #1264 would set, and a public payload shape is a ruling, not a builder choice. Options: (A) settle #1264 first, #1339 follows mechanically; (B) the builder defines the type inside #1339 and risks two shapes; (C) do nothing. Recommendation: A, so deciding bf4a5af5 also unblocks this. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low, but it is the reason the group builds nothing today.
Also: srs-rust#1132 has no "Answers: SP-nn" line, so the builder's claim refuses it; adding one is an owner or analyst call.
Still waiting on you, unchanged: srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP), srs-rust#683 (MCP multi-repo, parked), srs-rust#1198 (catalog cache), srs#236 (history note).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group; no builder-proposed decision had a merged PR with reviewer assent. Owner rulings this cycle: srs-rust#1440 answer A1, clarify [R8] for the two-pass reading as a correction-class revision (10-23 09:57, comment on the PR).

3. Done: 1 PR merged, none delegated.
- srs-rust#1438 (RFC-051 write sets for every outline operation): builder human:the-greenman / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate RFC-051[R8][R9][R11]/rfc-decision-be253dd6, approve; carried gate:owner-merge, merged 10:15 UTC by you.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs: srs-rust#1440 (RFC-052 revision 10, human builder; reviewer rejected at 10:34 on three blocking findings, builder fixed them in 24bca22b, reviewer approved at 10:50 with gates green on that commit; gate:owner-merge, so it waits for you). srs-vscode#145 (section order from entry order): still rejected on the 10-22 00:42 quorum comment (check-payload-schema-drift red); no push since, although srs-vscode#146 has merged, so it needs an update-branch and re-review. needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, #1264, #1339, #1342, srs#236. Every merged PR this cycle has a quorum line.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 1 open (srs-vscode#145). Pause state: running (the 10-21 report carries a thumbs-up; the 10-22 report is not yet acknowledged, so one more unacknowledged report is the limit before a pause).
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7fefad9 (proposed, about 17h) and bf4a5af5 (draft, about 35h; it is not yet in the proposed state, worth a look). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and workable: 1 (srs-rust#1132, P2, blocked for the builder by the missing Answers line). Ready but stopped (needs-input or parked): srs-rust#1339, #1342, #1198, #861, #704, #683. Top 3 in the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs-rust#1132, then nothing claimable. Open group PRs in flight: 2 (srs-rust#1440 awaiting you, srs-vscode#145). Budget left: 10. Queue running dry: 1 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: the fastest route is your ruling on bf4a5af5, which releases #1339 and #1264; after that the analyst's nominations and the spec-to-implementation drift list. Waiting on you: srs-rust#1440, bf4a5af5, c7fefad9 and the four items in section 1. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-20 late run: filed 0, nominated 8 (promote:ready on existing issues); no run since.

6b. Exercises: one open, the group's own (not listed in the SemanticOps log): "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable: RFC-038 [R7]+[R24] against rfc-decision-2e0cd70a" (2ac083c0). Input asked for: should an out-of-contract top-level key be a non-fatal diagnostic, or is fail-closed right and the LOAD verb narrowed to `meta`.

7. What we learned: the group's day was a day of owner-driven spec work (RFC-051 and RFC-052), which sits outside the delegated budget, so the budget figure reads zero while the repository moved; the reviewer's reject-then-approve on #1440 inside 20 minutes shows the quorum loop working as designed. A blocked shape decision (#1264) now empties the queue: two escalations on one root question mean the second should have been folded into the first. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is still ready to unpark; flagged again.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation record was filed: the only items outside the boundary (srs-rust#1264 diagnostics shape, and the empty builder queue it causes) already have open records bf4a5af5 and c7fefad9. They are listed again as waiting for the owner.
